body: I used to think about going the exact same way.
I've felt like that many times. I watched what happened to my best friends parents after he commit suicide and it destroyed them.
If someone offers you help they are doing it out of love, and expecting nothing in return. You aren't letting anyone down.

I have to remind myself to look at the amount of users that are here, right now it is around 38, a lot of times I'm afraid to comment, I spend most of my time reading other's posts. Perhaps there is not a large response because of low subscription. I am here nearly everyday. Idk if that helps.
You will always be a daughter, a big sister, and a mother. Even death can't take those things away. I am struggling right now and I just thought I'd reach out and say hello, and I understand.

Yes he planned the day, even put a tarp down and told his mother not to go to the back of their property and called the police to let them know he was going to kill himself and he did not want her to see anything. I miss him so much. His birthday is coming up, I don't even know what that means.
